# Crossfader 0.1.0-experimental: digiemu capture plan (OS 1.54, Core 2.1, Crossfader)
wait 1000
# SETTINGS > CROSSFADER: TRACK 1 in A, TRACK 2 in B, TRACK 2 on FADER ON
tap GLOBAL
tap DOWN
tap DOWN
tap DOWN
tap DOWN
tap DOWN
tap DOWN
tap DOWN
tap DOWN
tap DOWN
tap YES
wait 400
tap RIGHT
tap DOWN
tap RIGHT
tap RIGHT
snap crossfader-groups
tap DOWN
tap DOWN
tap DOWN
tap DOWN
tap DOWN
tap DOWN
tap DOWN
tap DOWN
tap DOWN
tap DOWN
tap 2
wait 400
snap crossfader-fader-on
tap NO
tap NO
wait 400
# the Internal Mixer: FUNC + LFO twice; LEVEL moves the fader
press FUNC
tap LFO
release FUNC
wait 300
press FUNC
tap LFO
release FUNC
wait 400
turn 9 +2 40
turn 9 +2 40
turn 9 +2 40
turn 9 +2 40
turn 9 +2 40
turn 9 +2 40
turn 9 +2 40
turn 9 +2 40
wait 600
snap internal-mixer
# track 2's SRC page: LEVEL is the fader there too
press TRK
tap 2
release TRK
wait 400
tap AMP
wait 1200
snap track-fader
